seo.title: Tikt — record what happens, in a single press
seo.description: Tikt is a one-press event and habit tracker. A rope is a timeline and a knot is an event: tap to record one, hold to say it happened a lot, and read the whole rope back as a chart.
seo.keywords: habit tracker, event tracker, time log, quantified self, tally counter
